translations.未经核实的部分先标出来，缺的容量数据再去问清楚。: Let us mark the unverified part first and ask for the missing capacity data.
translations.我把服务回执转给你，先按这个清单准备材料。: I am forwarding the service receipt; I will prepare the materials from this checklist.
translations.我把截图都放群里了，大家对这是规则还是系统故障还有不同看法。: I put the screenshots in the group; people still disagree on whether this is a rule or a system fault.
translations.我把帖子发群里了，大家看看有没有人遇到同样的情况。: I posted the thread in the group — see if anyone else ran into the same thing.
translations.我刚刷到床位结果，排序规则写得太简略了，我有点看不懂。: I just saw the housing result; the ranking rule is too brief and I cannot quite follow it.
translations.我看到了，先核对事实再决定要不要继续发。: I saw it. Let us check the facts before deciding whether to post again.
translations.我也不确定，先把自己的申请记录对一下。: I am not sure either; I will compare it with my own application record first.
translations.我也看到预约结果了，你的时段是不是也突然没了？: I saw the booking result too — did your slot disappear as well?
translations.先等等，我对一下刚发布的规则，再决定要不要转。: Hold on — I will check the newly posted rule before forwarding this.
translations.先问问同宿舍的人吧，别急着把截图转出去。: Let us ask the roommates first; no need to forward the screenshot yet.
translations.小群把不同判断放在一起，形成后续核验或转述的入口。: The group puts different judgements together, creating an entry point for verification or retelling.
translations.有人说材料少一项就直接排到后面，真的假的？: Someone says missing one item sends you straight to the back — is that really true?
translations.证据卡把每一步排序都列出来了，我终于知道自己卡在哪。: The evidence card lists every ranking step; I finally know where my case is stuck.
translations.成员发言保留了自己的疑问或补充，形成可继续追问的对话链。: Each member keeps their own question or addition, forming a dialogue chain for follow-up.
translations.对不上号的地方先标出来，别让它继续传偏。: Mark the parts that do not match before they spread further.
translations.如果临界分数还有疑问，我们再单独问一次。: If the borderline score is still unclear, we will ask again directly.
translations.如果有人拿到原始通知，发我一份对照下。: If anyone has the original notice, send it to me so I can compare.
translations.我把材料清单抄下来，免得漏掉最后一项。: I copied the materials checklist so I do not miss the last item.
translations.我把这个问题记在群里，等答复后再补充。: I noted this question in the group and will add the reply when it arrives.
translations.我去看看群里有没有人保存了完整规则。: I will check whether anyone in the group saved the full rule.
translations.先别把猜测当结论，问清楚再说。: Do not treat a guess as a conclusion; ask first.
translations.有新消息我再回群里更新。: I will update the group when there is new information.
translations.连接恢复后可继续编辑项目。: Editing will be available when the connection is restored.
